raw.descriptionHtml:

Hedge is hiring a founding engineer to turn complex commercial insurance workflows into software that feels simple, fast, and trustworthy. You will work across product, data, integrations, and infrastructure, with direct access to users and the founders.

 

COMPENSATION AND OWNERSHIP

Base salary is $150K-$250K. Equity is 1.00%-3.00%, sized for a true founding-level builder. Compensation reflects scope, experience, and the amount of the company you are ready to own.

  • Build and ship core submission, market-access, quoting, and servicing workflows

  • Design reliable carrier, MGA, data, and document integrations

  • Make architecture decisions that balance speed, safety, and maintainability

  • Work directly with brokers, underwriters, and agencies to turn painful workflows into product
